theorems.statement: ∀ (P d : ℕ) (p : Euclid (P + 1) →L[ℝ] Euclid P), (∀ (y : Euclid (P + 1)) (i : Fin P), p y i = y (Fin.castSucc i)) → ∀ K : Set (Euclid (P + 1)), IsCompact K → ∃ (V : Set (Euclid (P + 1))) (E : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) d →ₗ[ℝ] TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid (P + 1))) d), IsOpen V ∧ K ⊆ V ∧ (∀ (ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) d) (y : Euclid (P + 1)), y ∈ V → (E ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid (P + 1)) d) y = ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) d) (p y)).compContinuousLinearMap p) ∧ (∀ (ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) d) (y : Euclid (P + 1)), y ∈ V → exteriorDerivative (E ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid (P + 1)) d) y = (exteriorDerivative (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) d) (p y)).compContinuousLinearMap p) ∧ (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) d, tsupport (E ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid (P + 1)) d) ⊆ p ⁻¹' tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) d)) ∧ (∀ (ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) d) (y : Euclid (P + 1)), covectorEuclideanNorm ((E ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid (P + 1)) d) y) ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) d) (p y))) ∧ ∀ ωs : ℕ → TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) d, TestFormOnConverges ωs 0 → TestFormOnConverges (fun j => E (ωs j)) 0
